referee_caveats_inferred: Bubble fit is by eye with no uncertainties; the quoted parameters have no error bars, so exact reproduction of 12.5 km/s and 750 au is not defined.
The inclination is quoted as 54.4 deg in Table 1 but 58.4 deg in the 580 au distance sentence in Sec 3.1.
The gas temperature range is 25-100 K in the main text but 25-95 K in the appendix; the 12CO optical-depth mass is sensitive to the assumed T and to the CO/H2 abundance of 1e-4.
No second tracer or isotopologue is used, so optically thin mass and the 12CO optical-depth treatment are weakly constrained.
The jet origin is not tested; no jet is detected, and no other DSHARP system shows a bubble.
The ram-pressure estimate gives a negligible displacement in the present geometry, so the disk deformation relies on an assumed earlier interaction phase.
